title: Healthy Smoky Tunisian Rice Wrap
description: Salty, pillowy Tunisian rice wrap bursting with smoky paprika and fresh veggies, perfect for a sick day.
instructions: Rinse 140g rice and cook in 280ml water for 15 minutes until fluffy.
While rice cooks, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add diced onion and minced garlic, sauté until fragrant about 3 minutes.
Stir in grated carrot, cooked chickpeas, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper; cook for 4 minutes.
Add lemon juice and cooked rice, toss to combine and heat through, about 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and let the mixture cool slightly.
Warm 2 ti leaf wraps over a dry skillet for 30 seconds each side to make them pliable.
Spoon a generous amount of the rice mixture onto each wrap, fold in sides, then roll tightly.
Serve immediately, optionally with a squeeze of lemon or a sprinkle of fresh parsley.
